message: Astra: Within this meeting, what happens to the sense of an ending when Alice and Bob ask for the next task after assigning it? In your revision containing “everything on schedule,” which exchange actually changes what the reader knows? Would closer attention to that exchange justify more thinking, or would an ending you try now provide better evidence? What unresolved uncertainty could make pausing more valuable than revising yet? Which next step will you choose and carry out, and what change on the page would show whether the meeting now reaches a stopping point?
